incident-bot: [PAGING] SLO breach detected for streaming endpoint: model=redwood-rl-7b-int8 region=us-west2. 5m window p99=3.2s (+220%), p95=1.1s (+80%). Error class: streaming stalls / tail token timeouts. Paging: @emma (oncall)

emma: saw the bot. paging SRE and runtime. @lee can you look at recent profile/rollouts? any int8 calibration jobs in last 24h? :eyes:

lee: we kicked a calibration rollout last night for several int8 variants, redwood-rl-7b-int8 included. Calib job id=c-2026-03-14-09. It updated quant/profiles and KV cache hinting. Will check diffs now.

sam: runtime metrics show a spike in `kvcache.misses` and `streaming.token_latency_tail` aligning with the rollout window. Node-level p99 correlates with high GPU memory pressure on a subset of pods. logs attached: ```
[2026-03-14T09:13:42Z] model=redwood-rl-7b-int8 shard=us-west2-a kvcache_miss=1200 token_tail_ms=3200
[2026-03-14T09:14:03Z] model=redwood-rl-7b-int8 shard=us-west2-a oom=false mem_used=78% queued=42
```

marta: tagging cs for customer impact. Cassandra, any reports from customers?

cassandra-cs: several customers reported degraded streaming responsiveness starting ~09:12. Most common: slow first tokens for streaming sessions and occasional stalls that require client reconnect. Rough numbers: 42 active streaming customers affected, ~2.8% of streaming sessions in us-west2 in the window. Two enterprise customers opened P1 support cases.

jonah: rough triage — likely calibration change introduced quantization kernel path that increases KV cache churn for >512 token contexts. That leads to more synchronous loads and tail stalls under certain token patterns.

emma: immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic for redwood-rl-7b-int8 to fallback FP16 variant in us-west2, 2) disable the latest calibration profile for that model, or 3) scale dedicated shards. Prioritize minimal blast radius. Thoughts?

lee: I'd prefer 2) disable the profile (revert calib job). Rollback is quick and targeted. But fallback to FP16 is fastest runtime-side. If we route to FP16 we'll increase cost but restore latency.

sam: can do routing flip now. Command: ```
# route traffic for model to fp16 fallback
redwoodctl routing update --model redwood-rl-7b --from-profile int8 --to-profile fp16 --region us-west2 --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: Initiating routing change: redwoodctl routing update --model redwood-rl-7b --from-profile int8 --to-profile fp16 --region us-west2. Started at 09:19:05Z. Will report completion. :gear:

(2m later)

ops-bot: Routing change completed. ~72% traffic moved to fp16 fallback for redwood-rl-7b in us-west2.

sam: preliminary post-routing metrics: p99 down to 1.05s, p95 back to 0.9s. kvcache.misses decreased by ~85% on moved shards. Streaming stalls greatly reduced.

lee: I'm rolling back the calibration profile now (job revert c-2026-03-14-09 -> disable). If rollback succeeds we'll plan a safer staged rollout with extra KV cache monitoring.

ops-bot: Calibration profile disable initiated. Revert request ID=r-5748001234-1.

(5m later)

lee: revert confirmed. Old profile re-applied. We'll keep routing fallback for 15m to validate stability, then shift traffic back gradually.

cassandra-cs: informed affected customers about mitigation and temporary fallback to FP16. Two customers acknowledged; ops asked for timeline.

emma: current action list: 1) keep routing fallback for 15m and monitor p99/p95, 2) verify no data correctness regressions, 3) postmortem owner = lee, 4) timeline: rollback at 09:24, monitoring window until 09:39, gradual re-enable after validation.

jonah: for postmortem add: calibration test matrix gap where KV cache churn was not exercised; add synthetic streaming load to validation harness.

sam: added temporary alert to detect `kvcache.misses` > 200/min per-shard and `streaming.token_latency_tail` > 1.5s.

emma: thanks everyone. I'm marking the thread as paging-ack and handing off to lee for postmortem and follow-ups. If anyone sees regression when we shift back, re-alert. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation applied). Closing page, please file incident report with timeline and RCA.
